---
title: "My first weeks in MDS"
author: "Sarika Tasnim"
date: 2026-09-09
---

![Orientation day on campus.](orientation.jpg)


MDS gave us a genuinely warm welcome. Over a few sessions, I got to meet my faculty and classmates, and the standout moment was easily the campus goose chase — a mix of fun and practicality, since it doubled as a way to explore campus (and I walked away with a free MDS backpack). The final day brought everything together with an alumni panel and a dinner that capped off three memorable days.

Jumping into actual lectures after four years away felt strange at first — everything was new again, and the sudden wave of labs and assignments made the week feel a bit overwhelming. But as the days went on, I found my footing. By the time the week wrapped up, I'd worked through most of the deliverables, and what started as chaos had settled into something a lot more manageable.

Looking back, the nerves from week one have mostly faded into cautious confidence. I still have a lot to learn, but I'm starting to trust that I can keep up — and I'm genuinely excited for what's next.
